title: Legacy program insiders on UFO materials

tellings.quote: that's how people who are in the quote unquote UFO legacy program talk about UFO materials.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, refers to people inside what he calls the UFO legacy program, a secret, long-running government effort said to hold materials from UFOs. He says there is a particular way these insiders talk about such materials. If true, it would mean such a program exists and its members share their own way of speaking.
